data.name: Lethabo
data.gender_notes: Lethabo is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sesotho language, Lethabo means happiness or joy. In Christian tradition, this name can symbolize the joy and happiness found in faith. The name Lethabo carries the meaning “Happiness, Joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Lethabo usually hope their child will grow to embody happiness, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace joy and happiness in life
data.etymology: Lethabo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happiness, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lethabo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
